properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Test-only MD5: the epee HTTP-auth unit tests reimplement the client side with an OpenSSL EVP_md5 helper (md5_hex, http.cpp:329-332) to compute RFC-2617/7616 digest-auth expectations against the production http_server_auth. The production MD5 digest-auth in contrib/epee/src/http_auth.cpp is reported as a separate finding.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Sampled sites (25 of 122, consistent with the object's full file list) are overwhelmingly equality checks on PUBLIC values: block/tx hash identity and integrity checks (blockchain.cpp, cryptonote_format_utils.cpp), protocol signature constants (LEVIN_SIGNATURE, boost archive signature), onion-address checksum bytes (tor_address.cpp), cache-tip and null-hash checks, downloaded-file digest verification (cryptonote_core.cpp:1685, updates.cpp:89), fcmp tree-pointer null checks, and test-driver compa

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: All 17 sites are test drivers: rand() in LMDB's vendored mtest*.c stress programs (external/db_drivers/liblmdb — standalone test mains, not built into the daemon) and Python's random module in difficulty/functional test scripts. Non-cryptographic randomness with no security context; production randomness comes from src/crypto/random.c (OS CSPRNG) and libsodium.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The PBKDF2 implementation takes the iteration count as a parameter (uint64_t c); the actual count is fixed by the external polyseed C library (build-time dependency injected via polyseed_inject at polyseed.cpp:88-96, not vendored in this tree). Polyseed's published design keeps the count deliberately low — the 16-byte mnemonic secret carries ~128 bits of entropy and PBKDF2 only folds in the optional passphrase — so the below-OWASP-minimum classification stands.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: gen_ssl_cert tool: when a passphrase is supplied, the generated TLS private key is written as a passphrase-encrypted PKCS#8 PEM using OpenSSL's legacy AES-128-CFB (EVP_aes_128_cfb) — unauthenticated legacy PEM encryption for the daemon/wallet TLS key files operators generate.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Monero's first-party crypto-ops includes Ed25519→X25519 (Montgomery-form) conversion helpers (edwardsYZ_to_x25519, ge_p3_to_x25519, edwards_bytes_to_x25519_vartime) that map wallet/account public keys between curve forms (e.g. crypto::ed_pk_to_x25519). Classical Curve25519 arithmetic, Shor-vulnerable; part of consensus-critical crypto-ops.c generated from the ref10 Ed25519 builder. Changeable here only via hard fork.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Keccak (pre-standard Keccak-256, the SHA-3 permutation) is Monero's consensus-critical hash: tx/block IDs, tree hashes, address and key derivations (hash.c), HMAC-Keccak (hmac-keccak.c) for multisig/CLSAG-style key derivation, rct ops and device code. ~200 sites across 13 files. Grover-only quantum impact; replacement would require a hard fork, so it is effectively consensus-frozen.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Vendored BLAKE2b reference implementation (src/crypto/blake2b.c/h) used by Monero's fcmp/tree-sync path for curve-tree leaf and parent hashing. Sound hash, Grover-only quantum impact.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Production SHA-256 via OpenSSL EVP: epee TLS self-signed certificate signing and digest/fingerprint (net_ssl.cpp:179, net_ssl.cpp:371, net_ssl.h:186), tools::sha256sum (src/common/util.cpp:689/703), the inner hash of polyseed's PBKDF2, plus the unit-test sha256_hex digest-auth expectations. The http_auth.cpp SHA-256 digest-auth site is absent from this object and reported separately.
